first_accepted_patch:
--- a/rtl/counter.v
+++ b/rtl/counter.v
@@ -24,7 +24,7 @@
         if (!reset_n) begin
             val_out <= {WIDTH_BITS{1'b0}};
         end else begin
-            if (val_out >= limit_val) begin
+            if (val_out > limit_val) begin
                 val_out <= {WIDTH_BITS{1'b0}};
             end else begin
                 val_out <= val_out + 1'b1;
             end
         end
     end

parsed_output.root_cause: The comparison `val_out >= limit_val` incorrectly includes equality, causing the counter to prematurely wrap to zero when reaching the limit value. This results in the counter skipping the expected final count value and failing test assertions that expect the counter to reach and hold the limit value.
